change_summary: Restore the real D3D9 game-authored Draw/DrawIndexed native VB/IB buffer object chain through D3D11 IA for bounded diagnostic and full-resolution paths; ensure fail-closed on missing GPU owner with original D3D9 render and gamepad preserved.

feature_contract.goal: Menu, vehicle selection and race native Draw/DrawIndexed use actual populated GPU VB/IB across full-resolution and fallback diagnostic modes instead of null shadowed COM owners, preserving original D3D9 when native binding fails.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both real native full-frame and bounded fallback Draw/DrawIndexed routes bind the exact D3D11 vertex and index buffers populated from game-authored data.
Missing native VB or required IB fails closed before IA/Draw and does not change original D3D9 Draw, Present HRESULT or gamepad path.
Destructive source mutation checks and exact-SHA Fast, Backend, Win32, OpenXR and HUD GitHub Actions all succeed; game and HMD validation remain separate.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: A real full-resolution game VB/IB, populated through native GPU uploads and independently through legacy diagnostics, is bound to its exact IA slot immediately before native game Draw/DrawIndexed; actual game/HMD pixels not asserted.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native Draw remains opt-in disabled by default; any absent source VB/IB returns failure before submission, while D3D9 Draw and input path stay authoritative.
integration_path: R30 intercepted game VB/IB/UP Draw -> native full-frame upload or bounded diagnostic GPU CreateBuffer -> shared ComPtr source ownership
Shared D3D11 IASetVertexBuffers/IASetIndexBuffer -> Draw/DrawIndexed -> guarded same-Present native frame or original D3D9 fallback
batch_components: Live game D3D11 GPU buffer creation and shared IA object binding repair in C++ bridge
Destructive positive/negative real-source ownership regression executed by exact-SHA Fast workflow plus Windows source compile

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Both buffer creation paths retain their D3D11 COM objects until the shared real GPU IA binding and Draw/DrawIndexed.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Destructively reintroducing either scoped VB/IB shadow or removing the buffer admission guard fails source test; D3D9/gamepad unaffected.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: R30 game Draw capture -> D3D11 actual vertex/index buffer creation and upload -> shared IA -> native GPU Draw -> fenced original-Present frame boundary.
